Photorealistic documentary realism, original AI-generated artistic interpretation, not a photograph. Scene: the Roman Aqueduct of Segovia from the public Plaza del Azoguejo tourist viewpoint at plausible eye level, looking west to northwest across the plaza. The dominant geometry must match the real landmark: the very tall central double arcade of dry-laid warm grey granite blocks, narrow monumental piers, two stacked rows of evenly spaced semicircular arches, no mortar, the arcade receding naturally toward the old city. Include only real-world-type surroundings supported by this viewpoint: broad pedestrian plaza at the base, modest tan and ochre historic facades flanking the square, restrained street furniture, a few small non-identifiable pedestrians for scale. Keep the complete highest arches and useful sky margin; keep the aqueduct centered enough that a later vertical 4:5 crop can retain the landmark. Actual scenario: 23 September 2026 at 20:31 Europe/Madrid, DUSK twilight, 19 minutes after local sunset 20:12; approximate sun elevation -4.17 degrees and azimuth 273.83 west. Open-Meteo model: 24.9 C, mainly clear, 16 percent cloud, no precipitation, light wind; model data, not an on-site observation. Render honest early blue-hour twilight: pale amber residual western horizon visible through/behind parts of the arches, deepening cool blue overhead, aqueduct and plaza in soft ambient shadow. Do not invent stars, moon, wet pavement, floodlighting schedule, banners, festivals, cranes, logos, legible signs, or text. No dramatic HDR, no golden-hour glow, no cinematic color grade, no fisheye, no aerial view. Tripod-stable 35mm-equivalent natural perspective, neutral color, accurate masonry texture, crisp but not oversharpened. No captions or watermark.
